summary: A placeholder for an empty list, with an optional badge icon and up to two actions.

props.name: icon
props.description: The glyph in the badge. No badge renders without one.

props.name: iconTone
props.description: `accent` for an invitation to act, `neutral` for a plain absence - nothing found, nothing to do.

props.name: description
props.example: Invite team members to collaborate on projects.

props.name: primaryLabel
props.description: The filled button. Omit it for a state with nothing to do.

props.name: primaryIcon
props.description: A glyph before the primary label.

props.name: onPrimary
props.description: Called when the primary button is pressed.

props.name: secondaryLabel
props.description: The outlined button beside the primary one.

props.name: onSecondary
props.description: Called when the secondary button is pressed.

props.name: shadow
props.description: Wraps the whole block in a card. `none` renders it bare, with no card at all.
